description: Dual-Entry JSON drawer of high-signal code review smells scoped by file extension and layer role, disclosed with a Top-3 cap.

active_smells.title: Upward Layer Dependency or Red-Line Import Leak
active_smells.symptom: A lower or core layer imports a higher UI/presentation module or violates declared tech-context depends_on / red_lines.
active_smells.check_rule: Verify every new import against the owning layer's depends_on and red_lines in tech-context.md; report violations in the owning layer packet.

active_smells.title: SwiftUI / Concurrency MainActor & Lazy Container State Misuse
active_smells.symptom: Mutating UI-bound @Observable/@State off @MainActor, or placing top-level conditional 'if' branches inside LazyVStack/ForEach that break prefetching.
active_smells.check_rule: Confirm UI state mutations stay isolated to @MainActor and LazyStack ForEach items resolve 1:1 to a deterministic root view.

active_smells.title: Unbounded Subprocess, Shell Injection, or Silent Exception Swallowing
active_smells.symptom: Running subprocess/shell calls without argument arrays, timeout bounds, or explicit non-zero exit handling, or catching broad exceptions silently.
active_smells.check_rule: Ensure subprocesses pass list args (never unsanitized shell interpolation), propagate or surface errors explicitly, and enforce fail-closed exit codes.

active_smells.title: Spec Checkbox Claimed Complete Without Matching Diff or Test Artifact
active_smells.symptom: tasks.md or PR description marks an acceptance criterion complete while the pinned diff omits the required validation, edge case, or contract field.
active_smells.check_rule: Cross-check each active Spec Kit acceptance item and tasks.md checkbox directly against the pinned diff; never trust task checkboxes over code evidence.
